chunks: And by this chain, it was said: A man from the Ansar complained to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) that the houses had congested him.
So the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: Raise your voice as much as you can and ask Allah that He makes it spacious for you.

key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِ: The Helpers, referring to the residents of Medina who supported the Prophet

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet (peace be upon him) advise when someone complained about a small or cramped home?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, a companion from the Ansar complains to the Prophet (peace be upon him) about his house being cramped by surrounding buildings. The Prophet advises him to raise his voice in supplication and ask Allah to grant him spaciousness. This hadith is often interpreted as a spiritual remedy for physical constraints, emphasizing the power of du'a in seeking divine expansion and ease in one's circumstances.
